name: Konark Sun Temple
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the 13th-century Konark Sun Temple is an architectural marvel shaped like a giant chariot with elaborately carved stone wheels, pillars, and walls.

name: Jagannath Temple, Puri
description: One of the four sacred Hindu Char Dham pilgrimage sites, the Jagannath Temple in Puri is famous for the annual Rath Yatra festival. The temple complex is a stunning example of Kalinga architecture.

name: Chilika Lake
description: Asia's largest brackish water lagoon, Chilika Lake is a biodiversity hotspot hosting over 160 species of birds and the endangered Irrawaddy dolphins. A paradise for birdwatching and boat cruises.
highlights: Largest Brackish Water Lake in Asia

name: Lingaraj Temple
description: The largest temple in Bhubaneswar, the 11th-century Lingaraj Temple is a masterpiece of Odisha-style architecture with its towering 180-foot deul (spire) and intricate carvings.

name: Nandankanan Zoo
description: One of India's premier zoological parks, Nandankanan is famous for its white tiger breeding program, botanical garden, and immersive wildlife experiences set in natural surroundings.
